title: Kissed Sweet Jamaican Shrimp Skewers
description: A light and flavorful Jamaican dish featuring succulent shrimp, dark brown soft sugar, and a hint of Mediterranean flair, all perfectly balanced with a touch of wok-hei
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat
In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, lime juice, olive oil, grated ginger, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and black pepper
Add the shrimp to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade
Thread the marinated shrimp onto skewers, leaving a small space between each shrimp
Brush the grill or grill pan with olive oil to prevent sticking
Grill the shrimp skewers for 2-3 minutes per side, or until they are pink and cooked through
While the shrimp are cooking, mix the dark brown soft sugar and 1 tablespoon of water in a small bowl until dissolved
Brush the sugar mixture onto the shrimp during the last minute of cooking
Serve the shrimp skewers hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired
